readerCopy.body: One small action can reveal more about a possible direction than another long period of planning around assumptions. When Mars sextiles the North Node, initiative and forward movement cooperate, creating a low-risk way to test something before reorganizing everything around it. A call, application, new process, or first conversation can produce a response unavailable through speculation. Momentum is most useful here as a way to collect evidence.
